claims.text: Machine learning-based molecular dynamics can overcome current limitations in evaluating high-temperature solid and liquid thermodynamics of multicomponent high-entropy alloys.
The proposed method is applicable across a large HEA compositional space in both high-temperature solid and liquid states.
Current experimental and computational methods have limited accuracy, availability, and efficiency for determining HEA thermodynamic properties.
Machine learning-based molecular dynamics will improve accuracy relative to current experimental and computational methods.
Machine learning-based molecular dynamics will improve the availability of thermodynamic-property data relative to current methods.
Machine learning-based molecular dynamics will improve computational or measurement efficiency relative to current methods.
Machine learning-based molecular dynamics can determine melting temperatures of multicomponent HEAs.
Machine learning-based molecular dynamics can determine enthalpies of fusion of multicomponent HEAs.
Machine learning-based molecular dynamics can determine entropies of fusion of multicomponent HEAs.
Machine learning-based molecular dynamics can determine volume changes upon melting of multicomponent HEAs.
Machine learning-based molecular dynamics can determine liquid thermodynamic properties across a large HEA compositional space.
Lattice distortions affect the thermodynamic behavior of high-entropy alloys.
Variations in inter-atomic separations affect the thermodynamic behavior of high-entropy alloys.
Machine learning-based molecular dynamics achieves its predicted accuracy and efficiency by accounting for lattice distortions and inter-atomic separations.
The accuracy and efficiency of machine learning-based molecular dynamics depend on the quality of its training data.
The accuracy and efficiency of machine learning-based molecular dynamics may depend on the complexity of the alloy's behavior.
A comparative study against current experimental and computational methods can test the hypothesis by measuring melting and liquid-state thermodynamic properties.
The hypothesis is falsified if machine learning-based molecular dynamics shows no improvement in accuracy, availability, and efficiency over current methods.
